description:
Follow-up to JMAP-sc1b.77. JMAP-sc1b.77 landed the jscalendar-types canonical conversion (10 sites → 8 typed enums via the impl_string_enum! macro from jmap-types). This bead carries the parallel propagation into crate-jmap-jscontact-types per the bead's notes:

> Treat as one finding spanning both type crates: if .77 is accepted, fix in jscalendar-types first (canonical extension-types pattern for the workspace's RFC-typed extraction crates), then propagate to jscontact-types.

## Sites to convert (jscontact-types/src/lib.rs)

Scalar string fields where RFC 9553 enumerates a closed (or vendor-extensible) value set:

- line 150  NameComponent.kind   — "title", "given", "given2", "surname", "surname2", "credential", "generation", "separator"
- line 334  Title.kind           — "title" (default), "role"
- line 515  Calendar.kind        — "calendar", "freeBusy" (mandatory per spec, modelled Option for partial-response)
- line 696  CryptoKey.kind       — per RFC 9553 §2.6.1
- line 744  Directory.kind       — "directory", "entry"
- line 799  Link.kind            — "contact" (only enumerated value)
- line 847  Media.kind           — "photo", "sound", "logo"
- line 1009 Anniversary.kind     — "birth", "death", "wedding"
- line 1098 PersonalInfo.kind    — "expertise", "hobby", "interest"
- line 1105 PersonalInfo.level   — "high", "medium", "low"
- line 667  AddressComponent.kind — 17 values per RFC 9553 §2.5.1.2

Out of scope (HashMap<String, bool> keys): Address.contexts, Phone.features, Phone.contexts, EmailAddress.contexts, etc. Converting the key type would be a larger change with knock-on effects on the HashMap API; defer to a separate evaluation.

## Routing note (must resolve before claiming)

jscontact-types has a hard design constraint from crate-jmap-jscontact-types/AGENTS.md:

> Dependencies | serde, serde_json only — no JMAP dep
> Do not add a JMAP dependency — this crate is JMAP-free

The impl_string_enum! macro lives in jmap-types. To use it here, jscontact-types would need to take a jmap-types dep, violating the constraint. Two paths:

  (A) Get explicit permission to add jmap-types as a dep (preferred — keeps the workspace cookie-cutter consistent).
  (B) Write manual Serialize/Deserialize/Display impls per enum (matches the precedent in crate-jmap-chat-client/src/types.rs ChatMemberRole/BodyType — ~30 LOC per enum vs ~10 LOC with the macro).

Decision belongs to Mark; labeled 'human' until that lands.

## Pattern reference

jscalendar-types final shape (JMAP-sc1b.77, commit landed this session):

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
#[non_exhaustive]
pub enum Weekday {
    Monday, Tuesday, /* ... */ Sunday,
    Other(String),
}
impl_string_enum!(Weekday, "a JSCalendar weekday string",
    "mo" => Monday, /* ... */ "su" => Sunday,
);
```

Each new enum carries round-trip tests for known variant + Other(String).

## Acceptance

- All 11 sites above converted to typed enum
- Round-trip tests for each new enum (known variant + Other catch-all)
- Consumer (crate-jmap-contacts-types) tests updated for new field types
- cargo test -p jmap-jscontact-types -p jmap-contacts-types clean
- cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings clean

## Memory references
- agents-md-result-enum-pattern-doc-vs-reality
- jscontact-types-jmap-free-constraint
notes:
Labeled 'human': bead description's Routing Note section captures the open design question (jscontact-types AGENTS.md prohibits jmap-types dep, conflicts with impl_string_enum! macro reuse). Mark needs to pick path A (allow the dep, cookie-cutter clean) or path B (manual impls per enum, ~3x LOC) before the autonomous /do-beads loop can pick this up.
Decision (2026-05-11, Mark): wontfix — close.

Rationale (Mark's words): in the contacts ecosystem, 'the RFC can enumerate all it wants, and literally nobody does it like the RFC says'. Real-world wire traffic from Outlook, Google, Apple, vCard exporters, and localized clients routinely sends classifier-string values outside RFC 9553's enumeration. Typing these into typed enums with Other(String) catch-all creates a fiction where the catch-all does the real work and the named variants do no programmatic dispatch. Maintenance burden (variant additions on spec revisions, non_exhaustive surface, consumer-crate ripples) is paid for no benefit.

Routing question (path A: allow jmap-types dep / path B: hand-written impls) becomes moot — neither will be done.

Cross-link: workspace AGENTS.md policy narrowing filed as JMAP-sc1b.110 to prevent re-litigation. Parallel revert of the analogous jscalendar-types conversion (JMAP-sc1b.77) filed as JMAP-sc1b.111 so both type crates land in the same posture.

This decision does NOT touch JMAP-native enums (MailboxRole, ChatKind, EmojiKind, NodeType, ParticipantRole, etc.) — those remain typed per JMAP-sc1b.110's preserved in-scope policy.
title: jscontact-types: propagate enumerated-string -> typed enum conversion
